description: This file defines a template class LexerImpl for reading and parsing binary data, including functions for reading various integer types, ULEB/ SLEB encodings, and string data, used in unwinding or profiling contexts within the torch::unwind namespace.

classes.name: LexerImpl
classes.description: A template class for reading binary data with optional bounds checking, supporting various encoding schemes used in unwinding.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads a value of type T from the current position.

methods.name: readSLEB128
methods.description: Reads a signed LEB128 encoded integer.

methods.name: readULEB128
methods.description: Reads an unsigned LEB128 encoded integer.

methods.name: readEncoded
methods.description: Reads encoded data based on DW_EH_PE encoding.

methods.name: readEncodedOr
methods.description: Reads encoded data or returns a default value if encoding is omitted.

methods.name: readSectionLength
methods.description: Reads section length, handling special 0xFFFFFFFF case.

methods.name: skip
methods.description: Advances the read position by specified bytes.

methods.name: readEncodedValue
methods.description: Reads a value based on specific DW_EH_PE encoding.
